title: Hirobius Tenant Metadata
description: Identity and brand metadata for one overlay: a direction in this repo (directions/<slug>/metadata.json, ADR-035) or a client's brand overlay kept in that client's own repo. Token values live in the sibling tokens.json; this file is for tooling that needs the facts without parsing DTCG. Field contract: docs/architecture/tenant-token-overlay-format.md (metadata.json section); scripts/check-tenant-tokens.mjs enforces its M1-M3 subset. A direction keeps deployment and legal empty at tier 1; scripts/lib/figma-brand-modes.mjs refuses anything else.

slug.description: Verbatim data-brand / data-tenant attribute value. Must match the directory name (M1). A leading underscore marks a non-deployable directory such as _template.

displayName.description: UI-facing brand name, rendered in tenant-aware screens.

tagline.description: Short brand line used by previews and sales tooling.

demo.description: Retired (ADR-035): the directions/ folder is the statement that an overlay is a shared art direction, not a client. Still accepted so older files validate; tooling ignores it.

tier.description: 1 = brand presence (marketing site), 2 = e-commerce (Stripe Checkout, legal pages), 3 = product (custom auth/dashboards). Drives infra defaults.

deployment.description: Where this tenant ships. Null until the deployment exists.

brand.description: Quick-reference brand info. The source of truth for values is tokens.json.

legal.description: Entity and jurisdiction. Fill before a tier 2+ tenant goes live; drives legal-page generation and Stripe wiring.

createdAt.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the tenant was scaffolded.

_notes.description: Free-form maintainer notes. Ignored by tooling.
